threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still checking Google Maps for the bus routes. The locals know the best ones are always just a 5-minute walk away.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Peckham. A guy serenaded the driver with an off-key version of 'Wonderwall' while two pigeons squabbled over a chip. Only in London.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy jogging with his dog in a full business suit, holding a coffee in one hand and a yoga mat under the other. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you order a currywurst at 3 AM from a food stand surrounded by techno beats and random street art—perfect late-night fuel.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they casually talk about the time BART was down for a week. A fresh-off-the-plane techie just wonders why the train's late.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo getting on the 19 Polk. Looked like he just left a wedding and headed straight to a block party. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss that the real magic of Gràcia isn’t in Park Güell, but in the small plazas where locals sip vermut on a Sunday afternoon.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they enthusiastically order their coffee in English, oblivious to the locals who just nod knowingly.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 149 bus is a reliable option after 10 PM. Good luck with that, mate.
Spotted a guy arguing with the driver because he wouldn’t let his pet parrot ride. Parrot was just chilling on his shoulder, not a care in the world.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh pretzels from the corner bakery at sunrise while the late-night party crowd still winds down. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a park where a bunch of grown-ups bring their kids to play while they sip on craft beer from the nearby bar.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how quick they get off the train at Civic Center when there's a hint of smoke—everyone else just freezes.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy balancing on a skateboard, juggling oranges while waiting for the 38. Classic San Francisco multitasking, right? Never a dull moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think it's all about Gaudí, but the actual charm’s in the little squares where locals gather for vermut on Sunday afternoons.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewilderment at the lack of tap water in most restaurants – locals just order a 'copa d'aigua' and carry on.
